verdict.rationale: Jitsu Functions are extensively documented as an in-pipeline transformation layer: filter/transform/enrich events in JavaScript/TypeScript before delivery, with a dev CLI workflow (jitsu-cli init/deploy), a functions debugger/editor to test on sample data, and pricing docs confirming you can filter events via Functions rather than routing rules. Missing for 10: independent hands-on validation of Functions in production (the only community feedback found is an old HN comment claiming Functions were absent at launch, which predates current docs and isn't a concrete recent contradiction) and no case-study evidence of complex enrichment logic in the wild.
